== Printing-specific Revised face ==
The physical white-border photograph linked below documents the printed face used here. The article’s printed fields follow that photograph, including the actual symbols and wording. The former seller-derived illustration remains available through its existing File page and the article’s revision history; its added lower-right badge is not reproduced in the new photograph. Existing identity, family navigation and unrelated material are preserved. The physical Light Side face also corrects the formerly displayed other-side artwork or text; no new executable identity or gameplay claim is inferred. The numerical creature attack box is recorded as Ferocity rather than Power. The genuine green Selective Creature symbol is retained; unprinted or unsupported default fields are not introduced.
